weapon.d: Inflicts Spd-5. If unit initiates combat, unit attacks twice.

assist.d:
Grants another action to target ally.
(Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance.)

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+4 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+6 during combat.

b.d: At start of turn, inflicts Res-3 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Res through its next action.
At start of turn, inflicts Res-5 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Res through its next action.
At start of turn, inflicts Res-7 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Res through its next action.

c.d: At start of turn, grants Atk+2 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, grants Atk+3 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, grants Atk+4 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk+5 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn.
